# units/kb

> n kb: kilobytes: 1000 bytes, as bytes.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/kb.pkg)

```
print 5 kb   // 5000
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 kb` is `2 * (3 kb)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} kb -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

